The <b>Crustnut</b> is a [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
The Crustnut is one of the five ingredients required for the <i>[[Great Taste of Pharloom]]</i> wish. It is given to [[Loyal Mergwin]] in the [[Choral Chambers]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Loyal Mergwin 01.png!Location in Choral Chambers
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Loyal Mergwin 02.png!Loyal Mergwin in Choral Chambers
}}

== How to Acquire ==
The Crustnut is found in a room in the [[Sands of Karak]], behind many breakable walls and floors.
